answer: Latency Sketch Registry: each agent identity is fingerprinted by the continuous shape of its request inter-arrival times, hashed into a fixed-width kernel density sketch stored alongside a freshly rotated pigment token. Enforcement rule: two identities whose sketches overlap above a threshold within one epoch are merged or the newer one dropped. An attacker must sustain distinct, organic-looking burstiness per identity across many epochs, paying real compute, scheduling delay, and detection exposure—one umber flag per flagged sketch—for every extra identity, so scaling syndicates costs scale.
